commands.review_summary:
The PR filters task records during snapshot iteration before cloning, passes gateway status, agent, and session filters into that helper, and adds clone-count and snapshot-detachment coverage.

PR surface: Source +21, Tests +82. Total +103 across 3 files.

Reproducibility: yes. at the source level: current main clones the complete task map before tasks.list applies its filters, and the submitted production-helper run quantifies that behavior. I did not independently execute the benchmark during this read-only review.
commands.review_followup: - [P2] A narrow automated repair can remove the production counter, reconcile the three-file change with current main, and preserve the already-proven optimization without requiring product judgment.

target.title: perf(tasks): reduce peak memory in snapshotTaskRecords by using Array.from with mapper
target.body:
## What Problem This Solves

`listTaskRecordsUnsorted` cloned ALL task records upfront via `snapshotTaskRecords`, then callers filtered in a second pass. For large task archives (thousands of records) where only a few match the status/agent/session filter, the entire database was cloned before any filtering could discard records.

## Why This Change Was Made

Before: `clone ALL (O(N)) → filter → sort → slice`  
After:  `iterate Map → filter during iteration → clone only matching (O(M)) → sort → slice`

The optional `filter` predicate on `listTaskRecordsUnsorted` lets callers apply their filter during the single Map iteration, so only records that survive the filter are cloned. When no filter is provided, behavior is identical to the original full snapshot.

## User Impact

- Eliminates O(N) pre-clone when the caller filters by status/agent/session
- Peak memory drops from O(N) to O(M) where M = matched records ≪ N for typical queries
- No behavioral change — output is identical
- Backward-compatible API (optional parameter)

## Evidence

**Head SHA:** `07613feb2b6511b02fdd56c4cc5e5cbe720e24b2`

### Rank-up P1 — focused contract tests (real production helpers)

```
$ node scripts/run-vitest.mjs src/tasks/task-registry.list-filter.test.ts

 Test Files  1 passed (1)
      Tests  2 passed (2)
   Duration  8.72s

Coverage:
- clones only matching records when a filter is provided
  (20 tasks → filter 1 match → cloneCount=1; unfiltered list cloneCount=20)
- returns detached snapshots for filtered matches
  (mutate snapshot.progressSummary; getTaskById still shows original)
```

### Rank-up — real before/after clone-count + heap on large filtered archive

Ran against **production** `createTaskRecord` + `listTaskRecordsUnsorted` / `cloneTaskRecord` counters in `src/tasks/task-registry.ts` (in-memory registry, `persist:false`). No credentials / private paths.

```
$ node --expose-gc --import tsx scripts/repro/task-list-filter-memory-proof.mjs

{
  "proof": "real createTaskRecord + listTaskRecordsUnsorted (src/tasks/task-registry.ts)",
  "setup": {
    "archiveSize": 2000,
    "filter": "agentId===\"keep-me\" && status===\"running\"",
    "paths": "none (in-memory registry, persist:false)"
  },
  "before": {
    "label": "BEFORE clone-all-then-filter (main shape)",
    "clones": 2000,
    "matched": 50,
    "listed": 2000,
    "durationMs": 1.608,
    "heapUsedDeltaMb": 0.557,
    "heapUsedAfterMb": 39.238,
    "rssAfterMb": 219.66
  },
  "after": {
    "label": "AFTER filter-during-iteration (PR head)",
    "clones": 50,
    "matched": 50,
    "listed": 50,
    "durationMs": 0.954,
    "heapUsedDeltaMb": 0.099,
    "heapUsedAfterMb": 38.744,
    "rssAfterMb": 219.66,
    "detached": true
  },
  "reduction": {
    "clones": "2000→50",
    "pctFewerClones": 97.5,
    "matchedEqual": true,
    "detached": true
  }
}
```

| Metric | Before (clone-all then filter) | After (filter during iteration) |
|---|---:|---:|
| Archive size | 2000 | 2000 |
| Clones | 2000 | 50 |
| Matched | 50 | 50 |
| Heap delta (Mb) | 0.557 | 0.099 |
| Duration (ms) | 1.608 | 0.954 |
| Snapshot detached | — | true |

### Static / existing unit gates

```
$ npx oxlint -c .oxlintrc.json src/tasks/task-registry.ts src/gateway/server-methods/tasks.ts
✅ No errors

$ npx oxfmt --check src/tasks/task-registry.ts src/gateway/server-methods/tasks.ts
✅ All matched files use the correct format.

$ node scripts/run-vitest.mjs src/tasks/task-registry.store.test.ts
 Test Files  1 passed (1)
      Tests  27 passed (27)

$ node scripts/run-vitest.mjs src/gateway/server-methods/tasks.test.ts
 Test Files  2 passed (2)
      Tests  16 passed (16)
```

### Before / After call shape

```typescript
// Before
listTaskRecordsUnsorted()       // clone ALL records
  .filter((task) => matches)    // then discard most
  .toSorted(...)
  .slice(cursor, limit);

// After
listTaskRecordsUnsorted((task) => matches)  // clone only matches
  .toSorted(...)
  .slice(cursor, limit);
```

## What Changed

- `src/tasks/task-registry.ts` — optional filter predicate + early-filter iteration + `ForTests` clone counters
- `src/gateway/server-methods/tasks.ts` — pass gateway status/agent/session filter into `listTaskRecordsUnsorted`
- `src/tasks/task-registry.list-filter.test.ts` — focused clone-count + detachment contract tests

Fixes #105425

## AI Assistance 🤖
- **AI-assisted**: Yes
- **Co-Authored-By**: Claude <noreply@anthropic.com>
- **Human confirmed understanding**: Yes
